description: Sud-Ouest : Canalisations TMD - CCMP Pauillac - Premiers Effets Létaux PEL70 (surfacique) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES.
